title: Selina NDE 3565
content: On passing out I felt a sudden rush past many people's faces. They were talking at me but couldn't understand what was being said. Finally reached end of light to be kissed and sent back. Awake to have an emergency ceasarian.

elements.At the time of your experience, was ther: Yes Childbirth 'Life threatening event, but not clinical death' I had been in labor for over twenty-four hours and my baby had become distressed. I just passed out.
elements.The experience included: Out of body experience | Presence of deceased persons | Light | Strong emotional tone
elements.Did you feel separated from your body?: No I lost awareness of my body
elements.How did your highest level of consciousn: More consciousness and alertness than normal During all.
elements.Did time seem to speed up or slow down?: Everything seemed to be happening at once; or time stopped or lost all meaning Very fast.
elements.Did you seem to be aware of things going: Yes, and the facts have been checked out
elements.Did you pass into or through a tunnel?: Yes Through a tunnel of people drawn towards a white light.
elements.Did you encounter or become aware of any: Uncertain There were lots of faces and they were all talking but I couldn't decipher what they were saying because I was moving so fast.
elements.Did you see, or feel surrounded by, a br: A light clearly of mystical or other-worldly origin
elements.Did you see an unearthly light?: Yes I was rushing towards a white light.
elements.Did you seem to enter some other, uneart: A clearly mystical or unearthly realm
elements.Did you feel a sense of harmony or unity: I felt united or one with the world
elements.Did scenes from your past come back to y: My past flashed before me, out of my control I think the faces were saying stuff about me, not to me - but as I tried to focus on what they were saying I was already hearing the next person - it all happened very, very fast.
elements.Did you come to a border or point of no: I came to a barrier that I was not permitted to cross; or was sent back against my will
elements.God, Spiritual and Religion: point of no return? I came to a barrier that I was not permitted to cross; or was sent back against my will God, Spiritual and Religion
elements.Did you seem to encounter a mystical bei: I encountered a definite being, or a voice clearly of mystical or unearthly origin
elements.Concerning our Earthly lives other than: ally saw them Concerning our Earthly lives other than Religion
elements.After the NDE: tionships changed specifically because of your experience? No After the NDE
elements.Are there one or several parts of your e: My mother had passed the day before and I believe it was her that kissed me.
elements.Have you ever shared this experience wit: Yes Only just shared it with someone.
elements.Did you have any knowledge of near death: Uncertain Heard about the white light but didn't really believe.
